doc: Huge (1e30), negative, zero and tiny rows (no clamping, no cancellation of the large terms): the weighted sum is dominated by the huge rows, relative tolerance. Area-weighted mean: row means (float32 pairwise accumulation for a float32 image) weighted by cos(lat) in float64. A float64 accumulation of the same image differs by 2.3e-8 relative, so a port is within the float32 default.
